Practised number-line jumps from 46 to 50 and 50 to 100.

end.parentNote: Asha practised number-line jumps and finding partners that make 100. Vihaan used counting forward correctly for 46 to 50 and explained 50 + 50 and 80 + 20 using tens. There was a mix-up when thinking about 75 and its partner; it was not corrected before the lesson ended. At home, try quick pairs such as 20 + 80, 30 + 70, and 60 + 40, using tens counters or drawn jumps.
